articles.title: Nottingham Forest and Fiorentina eye Birmingham City's German centre-back Phil Neumann
articles.summary: Since leaving Hannover 96 for Birmingham City in 2025, former Schalke 04 youth prospect Phil Neumann has established himself as an important player in centra...
articles.body:
Since leaving Hannover 96 for Birmingham City in 2025, former Schalke 04 youth prospect Phil Neumann has established himself as an important player in central defence for the English Championship club.

Sky Germany is now reporting that the 29-year-old German centre-back has attracted interest from both the Premier League and Serie A with his performances in England, naming Nottingham Forest and Fiorentina among his suitors.

A move as early as the upcoming January transfer window is considered possible for the defender, who joined Birmingham on a free transfer in the summer of 2025.

Neumann, who has made 17 appearances for Birmingham City this season, represented Germany at both U19 and U20 level earlier in his career.

articles.title: ‘Great option’ – Bayern still in talks with £58.3m Liverpool attacker
articles.summary: Bayern Munich are still in talks to sign Liverpool winger Rio Ngumoha. The exciting winger has been featuring regularly under Andoni Iraola this season and t...
articles.body:
Bayern Munich are still in talks to sign Liverpool winger Rio Ngumoha.

The exciting winger has been featuring regularly under Andoni Iraola this season and the Reds value him highly.

Bayern were ready to pay a huge fee for him during the summer, and they still retain interest in the exciting Liverpool winger.

Christian Falk has exclusively told CfBayern Insider that Bayern were ready to pay a handsome amount of €70m for Ngumoha in the summer window.

Bayern were looking to sign a left-winger to complement Luis Diaz, and had targeted Ngumoha, who made a strong impact under Arne Slot last season.

The German champions held talks with Ngumoha's camp but any potential deal did not materialise. In the end, Bayern went on to sign Ismael Saibari.

Bayern would need a new left-winger, either in January or next summer, and they have not lost sight of Ngumoha.

Falk said : "It is TRUE: Bayern Munich were prepared to pay €70m [£58.3m] for Rio Ngumoha. As we know, Bayern have been searching really hard for options on the left wing. We talked about Bradley Barcola, whom they were in contact with, and they were also in contact with Liverpool's young talent.

"There were talks, his brother talked with FC Bayern, but it was a difficult situation for Bayern Munich. It was not clear if Liverpool would sell him or not. The price wouldn't have been extremely high. So, you see, the club's decision-makers feel he'd be a great option for Bayern Munich, which is why Ngumoha is still on Bayern's shortlist.

"In the end, they had to decide for Ismael Saibari. Rio would have been complicated, so they just looked to seal the comparatively easier transfer of the two. Bayern are still in talks with Ngumoha's camp, however, and he could be an option for the summer."

The 18-year-old has made one start in the Premier League this season, and a further seven appearances have come from the bench.

Ngumoha, however, has made four starts in the Champions League, and has been used as a right winger by Iraola.

The youngster is a highly-gifted player and Liverpool have high hopes for him. Obviously, every player has a price, and if Bayern are serious about getting him, they need to pay a lot more.

articles.title: Deeney slams Napoli’s Lucca: ‘One of the worst strikers I’ve ever seen’
articles.summary: Former Watford striker Troy Deeney has hit out at Lorenzo Lucca, calling the Napoli forward “one of the worst strikers I’ve ever seen”.With quotes via TuttoM...
articles.body:
Former Watford striker Troy Deeney has hit out at Lorenzo Lucca, calling the Napoli forward "one of the worst strikers I've ever seen".

With quotes via TuttoMercatoWeb , Deeney made the comments as a pundit on CBS Sports. Lucca has faced heavy criticism from Napoli supporters and the media for his poor form, and his row with Kevin De Bruyne during last week's 4-1 Champions League defeat at Porto made headlines around the world.

"With all due respect, he's lucky to be a footballer," Deeney said. "He's one of the worst strikers I've ever seen."

REGGIO NELL'EMILIA, ITALY – JUNE 9: Lorenzo Lucca of Italy during the FIFA 2026 Qualifier between Italy and Moldova at Mapei Stadium – Citta' del Tricolore on June 09, 2025 in Reggio nell'Emilia, Italy. (Photo by Alessandro Sabattini/Getty Images)

The former Watford captain also couldn't believe how Lucca had spoken to De Bruyne at the Estádio do Dragão.

" He told Kevin De Bruyne , who has won everything there is to win in football, to f*** off," he said.

"Stop looking around and talking. Start working hard. That's the only thing you need to do. You can complain, or you can just shut up, do your job and look at the results at the end. These players talk too much. It's always someone else's fault."

Lucca came off the bench in Sunday's 1-1 draw with Lazio and forced Christos Mandas into a save, but his future at Napoli is in doubt. He's expected to leave on loan in January, while Max Allegri wants a new striker, with Monza's Gustavo Varela among the targets.

articles.title: ‘Furious’ – Troy Aikman’s expressions during MNF with Joe Buck have fans talking about their tension
articles.summary: The drama between ESPN’s lead Monday Night Football commentary duo Joe Buck and Troy Aikman seems to be getting worse in the eyes of fans. Aikman and Buck ha...
articles.body:
The drama between ESPN's lead Monday Night Football commentary duo Joe Buck and Troy Aikman seems to be getting worse in the eyes of fans.

Aikman and Buck have had a highly publicised fallout this season over their respective contract statuses with ESPN. Buck signed a new six-year, $108 million deal to stay with the network, while Aikman is yet to be contacted about an extension and is widely expected to leave after Super Bowl LXI.

Amid reports of behind-the-scenes tension and an apparent strain on their on-air chemistry, fans are still discussing Aikman's negative body language towards Buck when they're on-air together.

Troy Aikman's on-air expression has fans talking about his tension with Joe Buck

A video of Aikman and Buck on-air together has gone viral, with the fan highlighting Aikman's visibly uncomfortable look while Buck is talking.

"Well, Aikman is one of the best players ever and an absolute supreme analyst and commentator. ESPN is trash," said one Aikman fan .

"Instead of just doing the same post every Monday night, maybe compare this with footage of Aikman's facial expressions last season. But that would take actual effort," said one fan , believing that these expressions are regular for Aikman and this is an attempt to sell non-existent discord.

"Bro looks like he wants to choke Joe Buck," were the thoughts of one fan .

"Troy wants to punch him," said another fan .

"Buck and Aikman in the pre-production meeting," said a fan with a GIF from The Sopranos .

Despite the public backlash, ESPN has yet to engage in talks with Aikman over an extension, with the 58-year-old expected to finish out his contract this season before becoming a network free agent.

Options like Tony Romo are already emerging as potential contenders to be Buck's future partner if Aikman leaves, ending their 20+-year partnership in the booth.

articles.title: Projecting where Notre Dame lands in second CFP Poll of 2026
articles.summary: Notre Dame football is sure to rise in the College Football Playoff rankings, and here is a guess at where the Irish will land.
articles.body:
Notre Dame football did what the College Football Playoff committee wanted on Saturday, upsetting former No. 1 Miami .

The Irish were looking for a signature win, and that's exactly what happened in South Bend, as the US LBM Coaches Poll placed them at No. 3 on Sunday afternoon. While that is nice, what is obviously more important are the CFP rankings, and the second set of 2026 will be released later tonight.

Entering the week, Notre Dame was No. 11, but is surely to rise. The biggest question is how far, as you have to except a jump over every team that has two-losses. That means at worst, the Irish are No. 5, but I'd expect higher.

Jumping Indiana makes plenty of sense, as their loss to Ohio State doesn't look as good as it once did. That puts the Irish at No. 3, which is a reasonable spot for them. Unlikely to jump Utah or Georgia, who should be the top-2 teams in the country.

Regardless of what happens later tonight, Notre Dame is in a great spot to make the CFP with just three games left in its regular season

articles.title: Escudero se despide hasta diciembre del Zaragoza
articles.standfirst: El lateral sufre una lesión muscular que le dejará fuera varias semanas
articles.summary: El lateral sufre una lesión muscular que le dejará fuera varias semanas
articles.body: Sergio Escudero no volverá a jugar con el Real Zaragoza hasta diciembre. El club ha emitido un parte médico sobre el futbolista y ha desvelado que sufre una lesión a nivel del sóleo en su pierna izquierda. Por tanto, será baja para las próximas semanas y no podrá ayudar a su equipo en los siguientes compromisos. El lateral fue titular en la pasada jornada contra el Huesca pero fue sustituido a la hora de juego, ya con problemas físicos. Hoy las pruebas confirmaron la lesión e Ibai Gómez tendrá que buscar un sustituto de forma inmediata. El técnico tiene dos candidatos encima de la mesa para jugar en Jaén este mismo sábado. El recambio natural es Raúl Pereira, pero en las últimas semanas ha preferido optar por cambiar de banda a Marco Sangalli y colocar a Jokin Gabilondo en el lateral derecho. De hecho, el andaluz no ha tenido minutos en los dos anteriores choques confirmando la tendencia de apostar por el ex del Málaga. También habrá que esperar para ver si Ander Herrera puede jugar frente al Jaén. Ante el Huesca causó baja de última hora por unas molestias. En principio, fue más por precaución pero hoy no ha entrenado e Ibai esperará para ver su evolución durante esta semana para tomar una decisión.
